lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Luna is dead, a Detective, killed at Dawn. That is the Town's loss and I want it said plainly. I walk the lanes after dark and saw nothing that explains this. Elsie, you have said little since we gathered. Where were you last night, and who can vouch for it?

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: With Luna gone, we must reason in order, not by mood. First, Umar has offered only impressions: fog, bells, paint. Second, he has pressed Elsie and Tess without naming one fact against either. Umar, what do you actually know, beyond colour? I will weigh your answer before I weigh anyone else's.

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Umar, you asked where I was. I was alone at my schoolroom desk, marking sums until the lamp guttered out. I heard nothing I can prove, as with Elsie and Tess. You have named three of us and proven none. Where were you last night, and who saw you there?

lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Umar, you have pressed Elsie, Tess and Hugo and proven none of it. Your answer about your easel is no alibi. I walk these lanes after dark and saw no lamp at your window. Hugo asked where you were and who saw you. Answer plainly, with a name, or the Town should weigh your fog accordingly.

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Umar, I'll take your points in order. One: you have pressed Elsie, Tess, Hugo and Silas, yet named no fact against any of them. Two: your alibi is a lamp behind shutters, which no one saw. Three: you dodge Silas's question with another question. Answer plainly: what did you actually see last night?
